verse.verse_1: Ha-Meem. (Alphabets of the Arabic language – Allah, and to whomever He reveals, know their precise meanings.)
verse.verse_2: By oath of this clear Book.
verse.verse_3: We have indeed sent it down in a blessed night – indeed it is We Who warn.
verse.verse_4: During it are distributed all the works of wisdom.
verse.verse_5: By a command from Us – indeed it is We Who send.
verse.verse_6: A mercy from your Lord; indeed He only is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
verse.verse_7: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them; if you people believe.
verse.verse_8: There is no worship except for Him – He gives life and causes death; your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.
verse.verse_9: Rather they are in doubt, playing.
verse.verse_10: So you await the day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke. –
verse.verse_11: Which will envelop the people; this is a painful punishment.
verse.verse_12: Thereupon they will say, “O our Lord! Remove the punishment from us – we now accept faith.”
verse.verse_13: How is it possible for them to accept guidance, whereas a Noble Messenger who speaks clearly has already come to them?
verse.verse_14: Whereas they had then turned away from him and said, “He is a madman, tutored!”?
verse.verse_15: We now remove the punishment for some days – so you will again commit the same.
verse.verse_16: The day when We will seize with the greatest seizure – We will indeed take revenge.
verse.verse_17: And before them We indeed tried the people of Firaun, and an Honourable Noble Messenger came to them.
verse.verse_18: Who said, “Give the bondmen of Allah into my custody; I am indeed a trustworthy Noble Messenger for you.”
verse.verse_19: And saying, “And do not rebel against Allah; I have brought a clear proof to you.”
verse.verse_20: “And I take the refuge of my Lord and yours, against your stoning me.”
verse.verse_21: “And if you do not believe in me, then have no relation with me.”
verse.verse_22: He therefore prayed to his Lord, “These are a guilty nation!”
verse.verse_23: We commanded him, “Journey with My bondmen in a part of the night – you will be pursued.”
verse.verse_24: “And leave the sea as it is, parted in several places; indeed that army will be drowned.”
verse.verse_25: How many gardens and water-springs they left behind!
verse.verse_27: And favours amongst which they were rejoicing!
verse.verse_28: That is what We did; and We made another nation their heirs.
verse.verse_29: So the heavens and the earth did not weep for them, and they were not given respite.
verse.verse_30: And indeed We rescued the Descendants of Israel from a disgraceful torture.
verse.verse_31: From Firaun; he was indeed proud, among the transgressors.
verse.verse_32: And We knowingly chose them, among all others of their time.
verse.verse_33: And We gave them signs in which lay clear favours.
verse.verse_35: “There is nothing except our dying just once, and we will not be raised.”
verse.verse_36: “Therefore bring back our forefathers, if you are truthful!”
verse.verse_37: Are they better, or the people of Tubba? And those who were before them? We destroyed them; they were indeed criminals.
verse.verse_38: And We did not create the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, just for play.
verse.verse_39: We did not create them except with the truth, but most of them do not know.
verse.verse_40: Indeed the Day of Decision is the appointment for all of them.
verse.verse_41: The day on which, no friends will benefit each other at all, nor will they be helped. (Except those who are pious – see verse 43:67)
verse.verse_42: Except those upon whom Allah has mercy; indeed He only is the Most Honourable, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_44: Is the food of the sinners.
verse.verse_45: Like molten copper; it churns in their bellies.
verse.verse_46: Like the churning of boiling water.
verse.verse_47: “Seize him, and forcibly drag him right to the blazing fire.”
verse.verse_48: “Then pour on his head the punishment of boiling water.”
verse.verse_49: Saying “Taste it! Indeed you only are the most honourable, the dignified!”
verse.verse_50: “Indeed this is what you used to doubt about.”
verse.verse_51: Indeed the pious are in a place of peace.
verse.verse_53: They will be dressed in fine silk and embroidery, facing one another (on thrones).
verse.verse_54: So it is; and We have wedded them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.
verse.verse_55: In it they will ask for all kinds of fruit, with safety.
verse.verse_56: They will not taste death again in it, except their former death; and Allah has saved them from the punishment of fire.
verse.verse_57: By the munificence of your Lord; this is the great success.
verse.verse_58: And We have made this Qur’an easy in your language, for them to understand.
verse.verse_59: Therefore wait (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him) – they too are waiting.
